content_of_post_to_answer: Why is the 'body doubling' technique effective for productivity, and how do coworking spaces naturally foster it?
answer: Body doubling works partly because it changes the social cost of disengaging. Alone, opening another tab or drifting off is invisible; around other people, even silently, your behavior becomes more self-regulated. Coworking spaces make this effortless because nobody has to formally “do” body doubling—the shared presence supplies a gentle external structure. The surprising part is that productivity often needs less motivation when the environment quietly makes distraction noticeable.
